03 / THE APPROACH

How it works

05 / INSPECT THE WORK

A documented automation workflow

The repository documents LangGraph orchestration, Groq and Gemini provider configuration, SQLite persistence, structured logs, and Prometheus metrics. A dry-run mode is available for checking the workflow without delivery side effects.

The project is in development. No response-time, delivery-volume, or business-impact claims are made here.
